How we know

The shop’s public Google calendar repeats a Montclair Cyclists Ride every Sunday and Saturday at 8:00 am from 148 Valley Rd with no end date; the entry was last edited Nov 20, 2025, and the shop’s rides page doesn’t list a Sunday ride (read Oct 1, 2026).

Last seen happening Nov 20, 2025.

Hosted by
Montclair BikeryBike shop
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

Calendar only. The shop’s group-rides page lists a Friday ladies ride and a Saturday ride, not a Sunday ride, so call or ask in the shop before you go. The shop says rides are suspended for wet roads or temperatures below freezing.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Montclair Cyclists Sunday Ride (Montclair Bikery) group ride

Montclair Cyclists Sunday Ride (Montclair Bikery) is a road group ride in Montclair, NJ. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Montclair Bikery.

A Sunday-morning road ride from the Montclair Bikery on Valley Road. It shows on the shop’s own calendar as the Montclair Cyclists Ride, every Sunday at 8:00 am. The shop’s rides page doesn’t mention it.
